vsa.model_answer: To prove : POQ is a diameter. Construction: Through O, draw OR||BA or OR||CD as AB and CD are parallel tangents. Proof: OPA=90˚( Radius is always perpendicular to tangent) OR||BA (by construction) OPA+ POR=180˚. POR=180˚-90˚=90˚ Similarly, QOR=90˚ POR+ QOR=180˚. POQ is straight line through the center O. So, PQ is a diameter.

sa.question: Prove that tangents drawn at the ends of a diameter are parallel.
sa.model_answer: Each tangent ⊥ radius at contact; radii along diameter ⇒ both tangents ⊥ same line ⇒ parallel.
